steps.caption: Notifications
steps.narration: Notifications decide which alerts the CRM sends you, and how they reach you.

steps.caption: Three channels
steps.narration: Each alert has three switches: In-app, Email and Text.

steps.selector: text=A client opened an estimate for the first time.
steps.caption: One row, one event
steps.narration: Each row is one event, like a client opening an estimate for the first time.

steps.caption: Switch one off
steps.chapter: Switch an alert on or off
steps.narration: Switch off what you don't need. Let's stop the email for Estimate viewed.

steps.caption: Saved right away
steps.narration: It's saved right away. The CRM says Notification preferences saved.

steps.selector: text=A lead came in through your website lead form.
steps.caption: More events
steps.narration: Further down are alerts for payments, your team and website leads.

steps.selector: text=Text alerts also need a text sender
steps.caption: Text alerts
steps.narration: Text alerts also need a text sender, set up in the SMS card below.

steps.caption: The bell
steps.narration: In-app alerts land under the bell, at the top of every page.

steps.caption: Bell list
steps.narration: Estimate opens, payments and team activity are listed here as they happen.

steps.caption: Close
steps.narration: These switches are only about alerts to you. Emails to your clients always send.

steps.caption: Menu: Settings
steps.narration: You'll find Notifications under Settings in the menu.

youtube.title: How to choose your notifications | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of Notifications in the ConstructHUB CRM settings. You will see the In-app, Email and Text switches for each alert, switch one off, and find the bell where in-app alerts land.
